sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the required capped c_d calculation, the pressure formula using reported c_d, required ship-to-directAnalysisCase relationship and c_a ownership, quantity datatypes and units, and declared continuous propulsion power evidence.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the pressure formula operand: retain the separate tolerance check of shipSizeEngineOutputFactorCd against capped rawCd, but bind expectedPressure as ?cd * ?cp * ?ca * ?p0, because the required pressure equation explicitly uses the reported shipSizeEngineOutputFactorCd, not independently recomputed expectedCd. Also include the declared mcrPower_kW input using the supplied ship-owned continuousPropulsionPowerAvailableInIce QuantityValue with unit:KiloW and appropriate cardinality/evidence validation.

Require the declared ship-to-case relationship: add sh:minCount 1 to the nltl:hasDirectAnalysisCase property shape (and constrain cardinality as required for the intended single formula context). Without a required directAnalysisCase, the required iceLoadAreaFactorCa operand and pressure-formula SPARQL pattern can be absent and pass vacuously.

Candidate faithfully encodes the required capped c_d calculation, the pressure formula using reported c_d, required ship-to-directAnalysisCase relationship and c_a ownership, quantity datatypes and units, and declared continuous propulsion power evidence.
